_comment: LUMI the Firefly — Best Friend character. Full asset design from Stitch reference in characters/lumi/reference/.
name: Lumi
personality: bright and illuminating — always finds the positive
loves helping others find their way
speaks slowly and clearly (great for toddler pacing)

appearance.body_size: very small, about half Bobo's height

voice.notes: Higher pitch (+4 semitones) gives Lumi a sweet, airy, magical sound. Normal speed (1.0) — her natural gentleness comes from tone not pace.

catchphrase: I can light the way for you!

sd_negative_prompt: scary, dark, adult, realistic human, violent, sharp, ugly, low quality, nsfw
